title: RELATED is BLANK for a many-side row whose key has no row on the one side
query: EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS ( Sales, "SalesKey", Sales[SalesKey], "Product", RELATED ( Product[Product] ) )

source.quote: In the expanded table, the new row has (Blank) values for the Category and Product table columns
source.supports: in the expanded table a row with no match has BLANK in the one-side columns

source.quote: If a relationship is invalid, the VertiPaq engine automatically adds a row containing BLANK in every column of the table on the one-side of the relationship
source.supports: orphans are linked to a row that is BLANK in every column

derivation: Row 1 has ProductKey 1 (Bike), row 2 has 2 (Lock). Rows 3 and 4 have ProductKey 9, which Product lacks: they are linked to the blank row, whose Product is BLANK.
